en: A black and white postcard image depicting a scenic river valley with a winding river, terraced hillsides possibly used for agriculture or vineyards, and a cluster of historical buildings with steep gabled roofs. The area is lush with trees and vegetation. A prominent building resembling a mill or warehouse is visible in the foreground near the water, and the constructed terraces on the hillside indicate traditional European viticulture.
